basic_info.description: Updated in a refined contemporary style, this 1 bedroom, 1.5 bathroom + den residence at 2200 Pacific offers a large private terrace with sweeping southern views to Twin Peaks and the surrounding Pacific Heights neighborhood. A wall of floor-to-ceiling windows floods the open living and dining area with natural light and creates seamless flow to the outdoors. The bright, updated kitchen features lacquered white cabinetry and a Bosch and Miele suite of appliances, and opens directly to the dining area. The grand-scale bedroom suite showcases three generous closets and a marble-clad bath with dual vanities. The den adds versatility to the floor plan, complemented by a powder room and ample storage. In-home laundry hookups, one-car parking, and deeded storage complete the offering.  2200 Pacific is a premier full-service building in the heart of Pacific Heights, featuring a 24-hour attended lobby and a heated rooftop pool with panoramic Bay and city views. Just blocks from Fillmore Street's renowned restaurants and shops, Alta Plaza and Lafayette Parks, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy light-filled indoor-outdoor living in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods.
